# Services Gap-Audit — Sambandh (Final)

## 1. Honest verdict

Today, "Services" is **not a services marketplace — it is a utilitarian personal hub** (`renderServices`, `public/app.js:3145-3169`) that stitches together four rails that were built for other purposes: the **marketplace** (products + orders), a thin **consultation** flow (astrologer slots only), **gifting** (membership passes + gift-a-product-to-a-match), and **verification/trust**. The pieces that are genuinely strong are all **cross-cutting platform layers** — verification (§20), mobile/PWA (§22), the design system (§23), and interaction states (§24) — not Services-specific features. The purpose-built Services verticals from the 24-section vision — discovery, a consumer professional profile, booking-to-delivery, a reviews UI, professional/customer dashboards, service notifications, service AI — are mostly **minimal or absent**, and the single "real" booking flow (astrology consult) is a **payment dead-end** that can never be paid or started (`src/routes-consultation.js:73-77`). Of 24 sections: **4 strong (all infra), 8 partial, 10 minimal, 2 wholly missing.** Realistically the consumer-facing Services product is at roughly **early-MVP / ~25-30% of the vision**, and much of what "counts" is borrowed from the membership/marketplace rails rather than built for services.

## 3. What already exists nicely

- **Verification & trust (§20) is the crown jewel.** Govt-ID (`routes-verification.js` `POST /id`), profession verification (`POST /profession`), Lakshan/Karma integration (`verification-checks.js:104-114`), an owner-only Trust Score with a weighted factor breakdown (`routes-me.js /me/trust`, `trust-score.js`), and consent-gated **paid verification tiers** with deliberately coarse, honest reports (`verification-service.js:51`). This is genuinely differentiated and money-safe.
- **Checkout & invoicing (§9) is solid where it's wired.** Server-computed per-country taxes with itemized CGST/SGST vs IGST split, printable GST-style invoices (`invoicing.buildReceipt`, `showReceipt`), real Razorpay UPI/card checkout (`payDirectOrder`), and multi-currency live FX (`fx.js`). For membership, gift passes, verification, and marketplace **products** it's payable end-to-end.
- **Revenue primitives (§21) are atomic and money-safe.** Per-category commission with tier bonus + escrow release on completion (`marketplace.js:58-66,149`), an atomic capped coupon engine (`coupons.js`), and one-time-redeem gift-pass grants (`gift-pass.js`).
- **The astrology engine (§2).** A full in-app kundali/navamsa/dasamsa/yogas/doshas/dasha/panchang/transit reading plus a real LLM chart assistant (`renderAstro app.js:2151`, `astro-engine.js`, `routes-astro.js:136`) — the one deep, complete vertical.
- **Gift-a-product-to-a-match (§10).** A privacy-preserving flow where the buyer never sees the recipient's address (`openGiftPicker`/accept-gift, `routes-marketplace.js:254-269`).
- **Mobile, design system, and states (§22-24).** Real PWA + Capacitor, bottom-sheet modals, enforced touch targets, a disciplined token-based design system with strong accessible focus/aria handling, and systematic empty/error/success states. The foundation to build on is high-quality.

## 4. Biggest gaps (prioritized by user value × effort)

### P0 — blocking; Services isn't real until these are fixed (small/contained)
1. **Consultation booking is a payment dead-end (§6, §9).** `POST /consultation/book` hand-rolls a bare `Payment` (purpose `marketplace_order`, no `razorpayOrderId`/key) instead of `createQuotedOrder`, so there is no gateway order to capture; `confirm-payment` requires `status==='captured'` which can never occur, and `startSession` requires order `paid` (`routes-consultation.js:73-77`, `services/consultation.js:69`). **A booked consultation can never be paid or started.** Fix: route booking through the same `createQuotedOrder → payDirectOrder → confirm-payment` rail products already use, and make `bookAstro` actually drive payment.
2. **Booked consultations are invisible to the customer (§14, §17).** `GET /consultation/sessions` exists (`routes-consultation.js:90`) with **no UI consumer** — no "My appointments," no scheduled time, no session status. Add a My Appointments view (also to the Services hub, which today doesn't even link to consultations).
3. **Booking notifications are silent (§18).** The `deliverNotification` pipeline is real and used elsewhere, but `bookSlot`/order-paid/`cancelBooking` call nothing. Emit booked-confirmed / cancelled notices — very low effort, high trust payoff.

### P1 — high value, moderate effort
4. **No consumer professional profile page (§5).** Consultant cards are dead-end display cards with no onclick; `renderProfile` is dating-only. Build a real profile: bio (needs a field on `Partner`), verified badge, aggregate rating, slots, book CTA, related professionals.
5. **No service reviews UI (§15).** The backend leave-review route exists with no caller. Add leave-review after a completed order + read individual reviews on the profile (with the verified-purchase badge the model already guarantees).
6. **No unified Services landing / discovery (§1, §2, §3).** The backend already accepts `category/city/tierBand/budgetMax/lat-lng`; nothing renders controls. Ship a landing with hero + category chips + search + a budget/nearby filter, and make Services (not just the Astrology tab) the entry to consultants.
7. **Calendar UI for slots (§8).** Replace the flat ≤8-button list with a date→time picker; add timezone display.

### P2 — bigger bets / lower near-term ROI
8. **No self-serve professional dashboard (§16).** `partners.html` is a staff console; the professional manages nothing and sees no earnings (already computed as `partnerPayoutCHF`), appointments, reviews, or analytics. High supply-side value but larger build (auth + profile edit + listing/slot self-management + earnings).
9. **No consultation delivery channel (§7, §13, §12).** No video/audio/chat/reminders for the session itself — needs a 3rd-party (WebRTC/Twilio/Agora) plus a consult-scoped chat thread. Highest effort; scope depends on whether consults are meant to be live-video or report/in-person.
10. **Promotions & loyalty (§11, §21):** coupon discovery, referral, cashback, seasonal, bundles, loyalty — all absent; growth features.
11. **Service-checkout parity (§9, §10):** extend wallet + coupons beyond membership; make `deliverAt`/`message` functional; allow gifting a consultation.
12. **Reschedule (§14, §18)** and **polish:** dark mode (§23), wire the defined-but-unused skeleton loader + offline/slow-network states (§24), sticky booking CTA + swipe (§22).

## 5. Recommended sequence (small shippable increments)

1. **Unblock the one flow you already have.** Route consultation booking through `createQuotedOrder`/`payDirectOrder`/`confirm-payment`; wire `bookAstro` to pay. *(Makes astrology consults actually work end-to-end.)*
2. **Surface "My Appointments."** Consume `GET /consultation/sessions`; show scheduled time + status; link it from the Services hub and customer dashboard.
3. **Fire booking notifications** on booked / paid / cancelled via the existing pipeline.
4. **Consumer professional profile page.** Add `bio` to `Partner`; turn dead-end consultant cards into a real profile (rating, verified, slots, Book). This is the anchor everything else hangs off.
5. **Reviews UI.** Leave-review after a completed order (backend exists) + read reviews on the profile.
6. **Services landing + discovery v1.** Hero + category chips + search + budget/nearby filter wired to the existing query params; promote Services as the real consultant entry point.
7. **Calendar picker** for slots (date→time, timezone).
8. **Professional dashboard v1** — earnings + appointments + self-managed listings/slots (lift out of the staff console).
9. **Consultation delivery** — chat-scoped-to-booking first (reuse the Socket.io chat, add session refs) + reminders; video later if the product needs live sessions.
10. **Growth & polish** — wallet/coupons for service checkout, gift-a-consultation, reschedule, promotions surface, then dark mode + skeleton/offline/slow-network states.

**Guiding principle:** each step ships independently and reuses existing rails (checkout, notifications, chat, ranking) — no big-bang redesign. Steps 1-3 alone convert the current dead-end into a working, honest booking loop; steps 4-6 turn the "personal hub" into a real discovery-and-profile surface.
